---
title: "The Reviewer's Code"
---

::: {.ao-story}
Sooner or later the work comes back across the reef to you, and it is your turn to be the reviewer. A good reviewer is kind and exact, and neither tires nor hurries. Learn the code that keeps both the work and the author in good shape.
:::

::: {.quest-dialog}
- **Goal:** you will review work that involved an LLM, kindly and effectively, and choose formats that review well.
- **Before you start:** [Send Small, Say So](send-small-say-so.html).
- **Time:** about 15 minutes.
:::

You will also receive LLM-assisted work to review. This quest covers what to ask for and how to say it. Reviewing it is the same craft as any review, with a few shifts in attention.

- **Ask for the evidence.** "Which test shows this works?" works better than "are you sure?".
- **Watch for the usual signs.** Plausible but unused code, tests weakened to pass, and confident comments that do not match the code.
- **Ask for understanding.** "Can you explain why this branch exists?" is fair for any author.
- **Say when it is too big.** "Please split this" is a legitimate review comment.
- **Be kind.** The aim is better science, so keep the tone friendly and aim at the work and leave the author's competence alone.

## Formats that review well

Notebooks show the difference well. A [marimo](https://marimo.io/) notebook is stored as a plain `.py` file, so a diff shows what changed. A Jupyter `.ipynb` is JSON that also stores outputs and run counts, so diffs are noisy and hard to read, though stripping tools exist. When you ask an agent to produce analysis, choose a format your reviewer can diff.

## Lore

*Further reading. Optional.*

- [Jupytext](https://github.com/jupytext/jupytext): jupytext project (GitHub), repo. Why read: it pairs an .ipynb with a plain .py, which is the format to ask a collaborator for when you will review their notebook.
- [nbdime](https://nbdime.readthedocs.io/en/latest/): nbdime project, docs. Why read: it gives notebook-aware diff and merge tools if you must keep .ipynb in Git.
:::
